scope: Independent source-cell integration and explicit discrete forward stages, developer-only. No fit, calibration, geometry recovery, camera or automatic-trace qualification.

population.rule: Retain every indexed scene, both q values, both lanes and all stage arrays. Do not select successful cases. Missing, input, numerical and work failures are durable outcomes.

source_grid.area_method: Clip each source-cell rectangle by the half-plane, then signed circular Green edge integrals. No polygonized-circle generator or Gaussian reference import.

arithmetic.optical: raw saved coefficients, independent direct float64 correlation, REFLECT_101, then float32
arithmetic.encoding: float64 sRGB, clip0..255, ties-to-even uint8, grayscale
arithmetic.decoding: float32 LUT then three sequential float32 Rec709 channel accumulations
arithmetic.rectification: Independent signed factored Keys weights a=-1/2, float64, replicated source borders, then float32
arithmetic.post: Independent direct float64 correlation by saved7x7 coefficients, REFLECT_101, then float32; compared with original automatic GaussianBlur, not asserted bit-identical
arithmetic.output_map: For q: [[1/q,0,16],[0,1/q,16]] maps output geometric pixel centres to source array indices

comparisons.saved_coverage_replay: First replay each saved source coverage through both stage lanes. This isolates downstream arithmetic parity from the analytic-D/polygon difference.
comparisons.analytic_geometry_replay: Then replace coverage by independent analytic disk/halfplane cell areas. Retain full stage discrepancies, total area, every query residual and all encoding code differences.
comparisons.decoded_replay_rule: Quantization is discontinuous. Count every code change; final PNG discrepancy must be <=(25/16)*sum(abs(post_kernel))*max(abs(new_decoded_source-old_decoded_source))+0.002. Also retain the raw one-level outcomes, without using this stage bound to relabel them.
comparisons.analytic_coverage_rule: Absolute per-cell difference <= inscribed polygon total area-loss bound + 4*eps32; signed total-area difference checked separately. Analytic segment area sum tolerance1e-9*max(1,R^2), assuming disk fully inside grid.
comparisons.analytic_unquantized_rule: Full output max discrepancy <=0.002+(25/16)*sum(abs(post_kernel))*sum(abs(optical_kernel))*abs(background-material)*(polygon_area_loss_bound+4*eps32). This is an engineering comparison, not a certified enclosure.
comparisons.geometry_controls: Closed-form disks/semidisks/quadrants/segments, empty/full/tangent cells, complemented halfplanes, partition sums, rotation/translation/scale controls and independent positive-area numerical controls. Keep every failure; no tolerance retuning.
comparisons.budget_controls: Budget refusal before stage work; preserve one unknown per query. Validate excessive dimensions/kernels/maps/invalid inputs; verify immutable outputs/input isolation and input-binding changes.
comparisons.serialization: Strict native JSON with allow_nan=false; no fallback invalid_python_value markers. Raw unknowns are null with explicit reason.

limits.numeric_workspace: 512*(source_cells+output_cells)+131072 bytes, excluding caller inputs and Python/allocator overhead
limits.work_definition: Source mixing cells + optical kernel products +16 Keys taps/output cell +post kernel products; grayscale encoding/decoding add4/source cell. Coverage geometry work is separate and source-cell bounded. Not a timing benchmark.

execution.stages: Implementation may be statically reviewed before the freeze. Freeze full implementation/tests/runner before numerical execution; after a failure, retain it and admit any correction separately.

primary_research.use: Sampling/reconstruction and prefilters are distinct operators. Background, not a qualification of this implementation.
Primary work on analytic disk/grid overlap. This implementation derives its own clipped-cell Green integral; it does not copy or claim to implement that paper's case tally.
